title: Durable demo orchestration and per-account caps by UTC day
steps: Accept 202 before the revision; run two replicas, lose a receipt and restart.
Race for the last slot, bulk without enough slots, replay across midnight, a charged Retry, and revoking the site owner's access.
Shift the JS clock against PostgreSQL; provision/fill fails after Retry, and a crash before the receipt.
expect: Only one revision/site/session/prompt through recovery; only QA PASS reaches Outreach.
Bulk is all-or-nothing; replay is not charged again; Retry charges one new slot and keeps the old work.
A stale lease does not write; a person who lost access does not continue fill/handoff.
Receipts identify the action, not clock order; a failure of the current action does not rebuild/refill by itself. A lost receipt only replays the same build/site, with no extra charge.
fence: Durable receipts, fixed identities, site permissions, leases and the daily-cap transaction; URLs are compose/copy only.

tests: two replicas compete for the last daily slot: exactly one action is accepted
bulk reserves all its actions atomically; insufficient budget leaves no partial batch
a timeout replay across UTC midnight adopts the same revision/session without charging the new day
a failed build still counts; explicit retry counts once more and retains its work identities
0 removes the limit but keeps usage; a foreign opportunity rolls back the entire batch
a stale or expired worker cannot write a receipt, even before another replica claims it
Steps never count failed content or unverified photos as completed work
Retry after a manual build’s QA failure is charged and resumes QA on its existing work identities
acceptance is durable before any effect; two replicas build/fill/handoff once and only QA PASS reaches Outreach
restart after site creation but before its receipt reconciles one site and one revision without another charge
restart after a chat accepted the prompt but before its receipt repeats the same session and prompt id
a failed fill never starts the agent; Retry resumes that fill on the same site
a later Retry cannot resume writes or mint an agent seat after the creator loses site access
a receipted provision failure stops its action; a new Retry alone asks the same build again
a crash before the failed provision receipt replays the same build without another charge
a Retry whose fill fails again stops instead of resuming its own failure
WO fill Retry queues once per action, atomically, even if the new fill fails
WO fill Retry never inserts a missing brief or restarts a replaced site’s brief
